identity.title: [v0.91.8][ci][coverage] Parallelize hosted coverage with shard producers and aggregation gate

values.review_scope: Review workflow topology, coverage runner shard controls, focused contract tests, and issue-local lifecycle truth.
review_prompts: Does the workflow make hosted coverage faster by parallelizing producers while keeping one authoritative final gate?
Can any shard or aggregation path silently skip required coverage evidence?
Are run ids, profile roots, output roots, logs, and artifacts isolated per shard?
Do focused contracts prove topology and failure behavior without overfitting?
Is the change proportional and free of AWS/product/runtime scope?
